51.source: Yellow House 51 has independent resident-directed layouts on all three floors. The accepted top floor retains twenty-one singles and its marked doors; 1. OG retains twenty-three singles, shared A and two balconies. EG has twenty-three singles, shared A, Sports room and Laundry. The resident-corrected Sports room is 6.20 m wide, with the A-wing E left module edge aligned to the L1/L2 boundary. Folded exterior evidence remains unchanged.

levels.label: EG · module layout
levels.source: Resident House 51 / EG general sketch and subsequent alignment correction, 15 November 2026: retain the single-room splits and N0; use Sports and Laundry in the common areas; retain inserted B and shared A; narrow Sports and align the A-wing E left module edge with the L1/L2 boundary.
levels.notes: Resident general sketch fitted to the accepted middle-floor modules: twenty-three singles and one shared A envelope. H/G, N4/N3 and W2/W1 stay split, and N0 remains beside N1. Sports is corrected to 6.20 x 7.40 m: its right edge and A-wing E left module edge align at U=25.60 m with the L1/L2 boundary. E/D/C/B/shared A and their hall move left by one 3.10 m pitch from the first ground-floor draft, preserving apartment sizes. Laundry remains 6.20 x 7.40 m beside N0. Each common room has one hallway entrance. Singles keep 2.70 x 6.00 m clear interiors, two 0.20 m side allocations and 3.10 m pitch. Halls stay 1.40 m; shared A keeps its 6.20 x 7.40 m gross envelope. Common dimensions are inferred from module alignment. Clear lime door ends are followed for Sports and A-wing E/D/C; other existing apartments retain the middle-floor pattern. B uses a schematic bottom-right entrance and Laundry inherits the stair-side balcony doorway. Openings are schematic 0.90 m widths; hinges, swings and exact jambs are unresolved. The independent outline has no residual gaps. Stair and rigid coordinate frame align exactly with both unchanged upper floors. The schematic former F window template moves left with the narrowed Sports facade; B keeps one window and A keeps two. Source facade geometry and window evidence are unchanged.

levels.label: 1. OG · module layout
levels.source: Resident House 51 / 1. OG drawing, 15 November 2026: split G-H, N3-N4 and W1; add N0 and two A-bank singles; retain shared A; align the enlarged A bank LEFT edge with L1 LEFT edge; add two balcony enclosures; ignore the blue-covered W-row.
levels.notes: House 51 / 1. OG is the second physical storey shown in the resident annotation. Only this floor changes; EG, the accepted 2. OG and all other houses are preserved. The plan has twenty-three single apartments and one shared A envelope. G-H, N3-N4 and W1 are divided into singles; N0 and two A-bank singles are added. The blue-covered extra W-row is ignored. The enlarged A bank moves right by one 3.10 m pitch from its unaligned sketch position. Its leftmost F module and L1 both start at local U=25.60 m; both clear interiors start at U=25.80 m. The stair and R/L core do not move. Single interiors remain 2.70 x 6.00 m, with two 0.20 m side allocations and 3.10 m pitch. Halls remain 1.40 m wide; shared A uses the accepted 6.20 x 7.40 m gross envelope with unresolved internals. The two balcony enclosures fill the remaining 6.20 m core-side gaps. Their 2.90 m depth is inherited from the accepted balcony assumption, not measured from this drawing. Visible lime marks identify doorway ends. Openings are schematic: 0.90 m wide, centred 0.60 m from the indicated edge with a 0.15 m jamb. W1 has no distinct uncovered lime mark; its bottom-end doorway continues the adjacent alternating pattern. The West balcony doorway is schematic near the stairs. The outline is the complete union of modules, halls, stair and balconies, without residual gray floor. The accepted Yellow coordinate frame retains the absorbed 0.40 m core offset; geometry is not scaled to the folded exterior. Room facade window symbols, doorway offsets, stair treads and internal fittings remain schematic. Folded exterior geometry and its source window evidence remain separate and unchanged.

levels.label: 2. OG · module layout
levels.source: Resident Yellow House 51 top-floor annotation, 15 November 2026: add A-wing E and N0, retain the three-room W wing, remove the blue-marked residual extensions and place doors at the marked ends.
levels.notes: Yellow House 51 top-floor arrangement follows the resident annotation of 15 November 2026; EG and 1. OG remain exactly as previously drawn and await separate instructions. The twenty-one single apartments are the nineteen existing top-floor modules plus E at the left of the A wing and N0 at the right of the N wing. The W wing retains W4, W3 and W2 only. The independent floor outline is the union of whole 3.10 m modules, 1.40 m hallways and the accepted 2.70 x 7.40 m stair block. The blue-marked extensions and other residual source-shell gaps are removed from this floor only. Clear single interiors remain 2.70 x 6.00 m with two 0.20 m side allocations. The room width is resident measured; room length, wall allocations, hall width and stair split remain the accepted modeling assumptions. The lime marks determine which end of each room-to-hall wall receives its door. Doorways are drawn 0.90 m wide with their centre 0.60 m from the indicated clear-room edge, leaving a schematic 0.15 m jamb. These offsets are not new measurements. Both E labels are retained as drawn: the added E in the A wing and the existing E in the East wing have separate identifiers and descriptive selection labels. The existing rigid Yellow registration and its retained 0.40 m core offset keep the stair block aligned with the untouched lower floors. Room dimensions are neither fitted nor scaled to the folded exterior. Layout window symbols, door offsets, stair treads and room internals remain schematic. The folded Yellow exterior and all original facade window evidence are preserved separately.

55.source: House 55 resident studies: 2. OG retains its accepted module plan. 1. OG has sixteen singles, four shared apartments and two enclosed balconies within the confirmed outline. EG repeats the apartments, with the extended cinema beside R and laundry beside L; all three blue-marked floor areas remain, including the unassigned stair-side spur. Folded exterior evidence is retained separately.

levels.label: EG · module layout
levels.source: Resident-requested ground-floor continuation, 15 November 2026: sixteen singles, four shared apartments, enclosed cinema beside R and laundry beside L, retaining all three blue-marked footprint areas.
levels.notes: House 55 / EG repeats the completed 1. OG apartment layout at the same campus position, including sixteen single apartments and four shared-apartment envelopes. The three blue-marked areas removed from 1. OG are retained on EG: two 9.30 x 4.50 m outer strips and the 2.70 x 2.90 m stair-side spur. The eastern common strip and its restored outer area form the cinema beside R. The western equivalents form the laundry beside L, as confirmed by the resident. Each 9.30 x 7.40 m enclosure has one hallway entrance near the stairs. The 7.83 square metre stair-side spur remains unassigned. Single apartments retain 2.70 x 6.00 m clear interiors and 3.10 m modules. Shared apartments A, W1, N3-N4 and G-H retain their 6.20 x 7.40 m gross envelopes, including the perpendicular hall allowance. The 1.40 m hall runs and 2.70 m stair enclosure keep the exact first-floor geometry. The confirmed 8.10 m W return is retained. Shared-apartment internal divisions, exact opening positions and floor heights remain unresolved. The ground-floor footprint is independent of the folded source exterior.

levels.label: 1. OG · module layout
levels.source: Resident first-floor annotations and the accepted 2. OG module plan, 15 November 2026; sixteen 2.70 x 6.00 m singles, four 6.20 x 7.40 m assumed shared envelopes, two enclosed balconies and 1.40 m halls.
levels.notes: House 55 / 1. OG uses the accepted 2. OG module plan at the same campus position, with the resident first-floor additions and cutouts from 15 November 2026. Sixteen single apartments retain 2.70 x 6.00 m clear interiors and two 0.20 m side strips, giving a 3.10 m module. Shared apartments W1, A, N3-N4 and G-H each combine two 3.10 m module widths with the perpendicular 6.00 m room plus 1.40 m hallway depth: a 6.20 x 7.40 m assumed gross envelope. The joined pairs have one entrance and no intervening room or hallway divider. Their internal partitions and net areas are not established. Both 9.30 x 2.90 m strips are separate balcony enclosures, each reached through one door near the stair end of its hallway-facing wall. The blue 4.50 m deep portions and the earlier stair-side spur remain outside this floor outline. The W wing is 15.50 m long. The resident confirmed an 8.10 m inner return instead of the annotated 5.00 m, preserving the 7.40 m top-floor core and all other final dimensions. Hallways are 1.40 m wide. The unchanged stair block has the requested 1.30 m flight column plus 1.40 m walkway. Door and window symbols and stair treads remain illustrative.

levels.label: 2. OG · module layout
levels.source: Resident-measured 2.70 m room width and user-prescribed 6.00 m length, 3.10 m modules, 1.40 m halls and annotated outline, 15 November 2026.
levels.notes: User-specified House 55 top-floor solution, 15 November 2026, drawn independently of the folded official exterior. Each clear room is 2.70 x 6.00 m (16.20 square metres). Its two 0.20 m side strips give a 3.10 m module, including 0.40 m between adjacent clear rooms. Hallways use the requested 1.40 m design width. The stair block uses the requested 1.30 + 1.40 = 2.70 m split. The 6.00 m room depth plus 1.40 m hallway accounts for the full 7.40 m wing depth. End-wall and hallway-wall thicknesses are not additionally allocated. The clear width is resident measured. The length, wall allocations, hall width, stair split and outline are the latest user-directed modeling assumptions. Door widths and positions, relocated window symbols, stair treads and 1.40 m landings are illustrative. No floor elevation or bathroom/kitchen partition is established.

OG, Gym in the east EG enclosure beside R, and Study in the west EG enclosure beside L. The full room inventory and vertically aligned stairs are retained. White’s folded exterior and source window evidence remain unchanged; dimensions and schematic openings are modeling assumptions, with service fittings and internal partitions unresolved.

levels.label: EG · module layout
levels.source: Resident-confirmed White House 57 arrangement derived from the completed Red House 55 EG layout, 15 November 2026. Gym beside the east R hallway and Study beside the west L hallway.
levels.notes: Resident confirmation for White House 57, 15 November 2026: use the completed Red House 55 interior arrangement and replace White’s previous provisional floor outlines. The sixteen single apartments and four shared envelopes A, W1, N3-N4 and G-H retain the accepted Red House 55 lower-floor arrangement exactly in local metres. The east enclosure beside R is the resident-confirmed Gym and the west enclosure beside L is the Study. Their 9.30 x 7.40 m envelopes and entrances match Red. The complete Red ground-floor footprint is retained, including its 7.83 square metre unassigned stair-side spur. The same rigid House 57 registration is used on all three floors, with no rescaling, bank shifts, shortened rooms or omitted apartments. The 2.70 m stair enclosure, 1.30 m flight column and 1.40 m walkway align vertically. Single clear interiors remain 2.70 x 6.00 m with two 0.20 m side allocations, giving 3.10 m modules; halls remain 1.40 m wide. Shared envelopes remain 6.20 x 7.40 m gross. The resident confirmed the matching arrangement and named differences. These are independent modeling assumptions, not a survey of White: exact openings, floor elevations, bathroom and kitchen partitions, shared-apartment internals and service-space fittings remain unresolved. Door, window and stair symbols are schematic. White’s original folded exterior and any source window evidence remain separate and unchanged.

levels.notes: Resident confirmation for White House 57, 15 November 2026: use the completed Red House 55 interior arrangement and replace White’s previous provisional floor outlines. The sixteen single apartments and four shared envelopes A, W1, N3-N4 and G-H retain the accepted Red House 55 lower-floor arrangement exactly in local metres. White has no east hall balcony on 1. OG. Its 9.30 x 2.90 m enclosure, floor footprint and doorway are removed; the west balcony and both halls retain their Red geometry. The same rigid House 57 registration is used on all three floors, with no rescaling, bank shifts, shortened rooms or omitted apartments. The 2.70 m stair enclosure, 1.30 m flight column and 1.40 m walkway align vertically. Single clear interiors remain 2.70 x 6.00 m with two 0.20 m side allocations, giving 3.10 m modules; halls remain 1.40 m wide. Shared envelopes remain 6.20 x 7.40 m gross. The resident confirmed the matching arrangement and named differences. These are independent modeling assumptions, not a survey of White: exact openings, floor elevations, bathroom and kitchen partitions, shared-apartment internals and service-space fittings remain unresolved. Door, window and stair symbols are schematic. White’s original folded exterior and any source window evidence remain separate and unchanged.

59.source: Resident-confirmed Green House 59 layout: 2. OG and 1. OG match completed Red House 55 exactly. EG restores the missing A-bank single within Red’s full footprint, replaces the N apartment wing and its local hallway with one Hausmeister enclosure, and assigns the eastern common area to Garden room and the western common area to Storage. Stairs align vertically. Green’s folded exterior and source window evidence remain unchanged; internal partitions, service fittings and exact openings remain unresolved.

levels.label: EG · module layout
levels.source: Resident-confirmed Green House 59 arrangement, 15 November 2026. Red-derived EG with the missing single restored, one Hausmeister enclosure across the N wing, Garden room beside the east hall and Storage beside the west hall.
levels.notes: Resident confirmation for Green House 59, 15 November 2026: the top floor and 1. OG match completed Red House 55 exactly; EG follows the supplied Hausmeister, Garden room, Storage and extra-dorm annotation. EG uses Red’s complete footprint and restores the missing A-bank single. The whole N wing, including its former internal bank hallway, becomes one enclosed Hausmeister area. The eastern R enclosure is Garden room; the western L enclosure is Storage. Each common area has one doorway to the public hallway. A single rigid House 59 registration anchors all three floors; no scaling, bank shifts, room clipping or shortened modules remain. The stair enclosure, flight and walkway align vertically. Singles retain 2.70 x 6.00 m clear interiors, two 0.20 m side allocations and 3.10 m modules. Halls remain 1.40 m wide; shared envelopes remain 6.20 x 7.40 m gross. The resident confirmed the arrangement. Exact openings, floor heights, kitchen and bathroom partitions, shared-apartment internals and common-area fittings remain schematic or unresolved; the red H marks the Hausmeister area and does not establish internal partitions. Green’s folded official exterior and source window evidence remain separate and unchanged. Schematic layout openings do not transfer Red’s measured facade observations.

levels.label: 1. OG · module layout
levels.source: Resident-confirmed Green House 59 arrangement, 15 November 2026. The complete 1. OG matches Red House 55 in local geometry, including its rooms, halls, stairs and any balconies.
levels.notes: Resident confirmation for Green House 59, 15 November 2026: the top floor and 1. OG match completed Red House 55 exactly; EG follows the supplied Hausmeister, Garden room, Storage and extra-dorm annotation. All sixteen singles, four shared apartments A, W1, N3-N4 and G-H, both enclosed balconies, halls, stairs and the independent outline match Red 1. OG exactly in local metres. A single rigid House 59 registration anchors all three floors; no scaling, bank shifts, room clipping or shortened modules remain. The stair enclosure, flight and walkway align vertically. Singles retain 2.70 x 6.00 m clear interiors, two 0.20 m side allocations and 3.10 m modules. Halls remain 1.40 m wide; shared envelopes remain 6.20 x 7.40 m gross. The resident confirmed the arrangement. Exact openings, floor heights, kitchen and bathroom partitions, shared-apartment internals and common-area fittings remain schematic or unresolved; the red H marks the Hausmeister area and does not establish internal partitions. Green’s folded official exterior and source window evidence remain separate and unchanged. Schematic layout openings do not transfer Red’s measured facade observations.
